notes.title: 👩‍💼👨‍💼 Startup Panic is live on Steam now!
notes.content:
[h3]Quit your job and build a STARTUP from scratch![/h3]

[h1]Startup Panic is out on Steam and the game is 10% off now![/h1]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/kkqrFgN.gif[/img]

[h3]👩‍💼👨‍💼 PLAY NOW: [/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1045610/Startup_Panic/

[quote]This game is a tech-tycoon simulator ideal for players new to the genre - or veterans looking for a bit of personality as their small company conquers the corporate world.

It is all about surviving the tech bubble, competing with rival CEOs, and expanding the office from bedroom programmer up to the heights of global corporate sabotage! As long as you don't get hacked... or kidnapped…[/quote]
[h2]🔴Watch the launch trailer:[/h2]
[previewyoutube=Bb9L5ik9PmA;full][/previewyoutube]

As you can imagine, entrepreneurship is not easy and you get to experience realistic situations a Startup founder will encounter. Work out your strategies carefully and conquer the globe!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/dYgOWAR.gif[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Iw8i3g6.gif[/img]

[olist]
[*] Develop, revise and upgrade your features as they are the cornerstone of your business’ success.
[*] Form a great team with various hiring approaches, train your staff and grant vacations to keep them motivated!
[*] Compete with rival CEOs, deal with constant threats on the market share and expand to build branches in the entire globe!
[*] Most importantly, keep your company afloat and nurture a positive brand impression!
[/olist]

[hr][/hr]

[h1]New features:[/h1]
If you have tried out the game before, please note that this launch on Steam has added a couple of new features that you have never seen before! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/DJycwAp.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] Competitor CEOs that you defeated will return later with additional comeback-themed content and an option to upgrade your features to Advanced versions;
[*] A ghost-busting questline is triggered when you start to discover some haunted incidents in your office!
[*] Long-term loyal employees will earn new traits after gaining experience;
[*] Choose from Easy, Medium and Hard difficulty levels to face with challenges that suit your preferences;
[*] Some updates on balance and clarity. 
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/8z7lFQz.gif[/img]

[h3]Ready to write your business legend now? We look forward to seeing your great Startups![/h3]

[h3]In the meantime, come hang out at our social pages![/h3]

[i][list]
[*] [url=https://discord.gg/JtTUBHn]Discord[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.facebook.com/startuppanic/]Facebook[/url]
[*] [url=https://twitter.com/startuppanic]Twitter[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.startuppanic.com/]Website[/url]
[/list][/i]

[h3]Have fun and best of luck, entrepreneurs![/h3]

notes.title: Startup Panic is coming to Steam on January 20th, 2022!
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings Future CEOs! [/h1]

[h1]Startup Panic will be available on Steam on January 20th, 2022![/h1]

[h3]Prepare yourself to create your own company, beat fierce competitors, or be kidnapped by a pirate.👀[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39276504/f65bb3bbedec5e6c7510be1c53f5863da0bcb283.png[/img]

[h3]WISHLIST NOW![/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1045610/Startup_Panic/

[hr][/hr]

This launch on Steam will bring more [b]extended gameplay[/b], [b]new content[/b], and [b]a ghost to haunt your company to eternity[/b]. If you wonder, "what kind of startup game has a pirate and ghost in it?" so do we. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39276504/30eb241e6d89124968510286a6590cc961f8fb8a.png[/img]

[h3]Stay tuned for:[/h3]
[list]
[*] 🎮 [b]Extended gameplay[/b] - Competitor CEOs that you defeated will return later with additional comeback-themed content and an option to upgrade your features to Advanced versions;
[*] 👀 [b]New content[/b] - Long-term loyal employees will earn new traits after gaining experience;
[*] ⁉️ [b]A ghost-busting quest line[/b] is triggered when you start to discover some haunted incidents in your office!
[*] [b]AND MORE![/b]
[/list]

[h3]If you cannot wait for some sneak peeks or want to mingle with fellow entrepreneurs, come hang out at our social pages![/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/psBa6Mm.gif[/img]

[i][list]
[*] [url=https://discord.gg/JtTUBHn]Discord[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.facebook.com/startuppanic/]Facebook[/url]
[*] [url=https://twitter.com/startuppanic]Twitter[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.startuppanic.com/]Website[/url]
[/list][/i]

[h3]That’s it for today, we look forward to seeing your awesome STARTUPs and don't forget to Wishlist the game![/h3]
